briefing.headline: No solid material in PSI was tested above 22.2 % O₂ — the Moon base runs at 34 %.

sentences.text: No PSI test-level data exists for the Solid phase in this region, so this briefing is extrapolation.

Material contrasts at 22.1 % O₂ show PMMA burned while silicone self-extinguished, highlighting material-specific sensitivity.
